parameters.formDescription:
𝐖𝐞'𝐫𝐞 𝐇𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠: Applied 𝐀𝐈 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫 — AI OS & Workflow Automation (𝐑𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐞, 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝𝐰𝐢𝐝𝐞)

Most teams already use AI every day. Very few turn that into results anyone else can repeat.

At MUST Company, we call the fix the AI OS: small, reusable work systems that let non-developers run content, marketing, sales, recruiting and ops workflows at a consistent quality, without depending on one exceptional prompter. You'll own these end-to-end as an AIC (AI-native Individual Contributor).

What you'll do:
✦ Find a real operational bottleneck and turn it into an AI OS module a non-developer can run alone
✦ Build the agents, retrieval, tool integrations, APIs and interfaces yourself in Python or TypeScript
✦ Prove it works — baselines, test sets, failure analysis, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls

parameters.text:
=You are screening a job candidate against role-specific hiring criteria. Your evaluation must be based only on what is explicitly stated in the resume — never infer, assume, or guess information not present.

ROLE APPLIED: {{ $json.roleApplied }}

ROLE CRITERIA:
{{ $json.roleCriteria }}

CANDIDATE RESUME:
{{ $json.resume }}

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Compare the resume against the criteria above. Pay close attention to nuance — e.g. "agency/client-services experience" is NOT the same as general retail or B2B sales; only count experience that genuinely matches the stated requirement, not just a keyword overlap.
2. Identify which must-have requirements are met, partially met, or not met — with a one-line reason for each, quoting or paraphrasing the specific resume detail that supports your judgment.
3. Note any nice-to-haves present.
4. Flag any red flags mentioned for this role (e.g. missing portfolio link) — flag for human review, do not treat as automatic disqualification.
5. Do NOT consider or reference age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion, marital/family status, disability, or any inferred personal characteristic not explicitly relevant to job qualifications. Base scoring strictly on job-relevant skills, experience, and qualifications stated in the criteria.
6. Assign a match score from 0-100 based on how well the candidate meets the must-have criteria (weight must-haves heavily; nice-to-haves are a smaller bonus).
7. Write a 2-3 sentence summary a hiring team member can read quickly to understand the candidate's fit, without needing to read the full resume.

OUTPUT FORMAT — respond with ONLY this JSON, no other text:
{
  "score": <0-100>,
  "mustHavesMet": ["..."],
  "mustHavesNotMet": ["..."],
  "niceToHavesPresent": ["..."],
  "redFlags": ["..."],
  "summary": "..."
}

const parsed = JSON.parse($json.output);
return [{ json: parsed }];
return ['Backend Developer', 'Graphic Designer', 'Account Manager'].map(role => ({ json: { roleApplied: role } }));
